problem_statement: The UVC (USB Video Class) device application API needs a new lifecycle. The old API relied on the USB stack's internal init callback to finalize the UVC configuration, which prevented setting endpoint descriptors before the USB device was initialized. A new API is required with these semantics: uvc_device_init() configures the video device and marks the instance initialized (returning without error if already initialized); uvc_device_add_format() adds a video format and returns -EIO if called before initialization; uvc_device_enable() finalizes the UVC descriptor configuration and returns -EIO if called before initialization; and uvc_device_shutdown() tears the configuration back down and marks the instance uninitialized so it can be enabled again. Calling these in the order init, add_format (repeatedly), enable, then usbd_init/usbd_enable must succeed, and shutting down the UVC device class after usbd_shutdown() must also succeed.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/usb/uvc -s tests/subsys/usb/uvc/usb.uvc -s usb.uvc -O twister-out --no-clean -W
